entries.subject: JWST NIRSpec rotational maps of Luhman 16 B (Wang et al. 2026)
entries.finding: Wang et al. (arXiv:2609.22026) map Luhman 16 B from the JWST NIRSpec monitoring of GO 2965 (Biller et al. 2024), but say their maps and code 'will be publicly released upon' publication.

entries.subject: The first Doppler map of Luhman 16 B (Crossfield et al. 2014)
entries.finding: The Nature map was published as a figure only. Ureshino et al. (2026) refit the same CRIRES spectra and deposit their map with its uncertainty, which is shown instead.

entries.subject: Maps from the other CRIRES detector chips
entries.finding: Ureshino et al. fit chip 2 (2.304 to 2.316 um, the CO band head) only; the deposit holds that map.
entries.revisitWhen: Maps from the other chips or a joint fit are deposited.

entries.subject: The direction of B's spin axis on the sky
entries.finding: Doppler imaging measures the axis's tilt to the line of sight (61 degrees) but not its position angle, which is set toward celestial north.
entries.revisitWhen: Interferometry or polarimetry measures the axis's position angle.
